_label: FICTIONAL, ILLUSTRATIVE BENCHMARK. Every record is invented for this local demo. The expected labels are illustrative judgements written by the demo author to show how classification quality would be measured. They are NOT Sohail Syed's approved buyer-signal criteria, which are still pending, and the scores they produce say nothing about real-world performance.
